stances.summary: Expresses confidence in Democratic coalition for November election
stances.quote: It was great meeting so many voters in Detroit and seeing the energy behind the coalition that will win this November.

stances.summary: Argues South Carolina can flip from red to blue in upcoming election
stances.quote: There is no such thing as a permanently red state, county, or district - something South Carolina has the potential to demonstrate in November.

stances.summary: Appeals to common ground across political divisions on shared priorities
stances.quote: It's all too easy to feel politically alone right now - but most of us actually agree on the big things we must do to make life better in this country.

stances.summary: Calls for flipping Indiana, positioning Democrats as competitive force
stances.quote:
This is the year to flip the narrative, change the balance of political power, and deliver a better life for Hoosiers.

I’m proud to be in their corner - and to see them proving that when we show up and give people something worth voting for, we can compete anywhere.

stances.summary: Suggests voters seek leaders with integrity and deep roots in communities
stances.quote: And as I’ve traveled the country this year, I’m more convinced than ever that voters - including in the state where I grew up - are hungry for leaders with the deep roots, vision, integrity, and energy this moment requires.

stances.summary: Argues Democratic candidates can win in Republican-leaning states
stances.quote:
There’s no such thing as a permanently “red” state, and that's certainly true of Indiana.

I've seen how great Hoosier Democrats can surprise the pundits and win, in uphill districts and statewide.

stances.summary: Endorses Luke Bronin for Congress, backs his vision and reform agenda
stances.quote: @lukebronin.bsky.social has the energy and vision that Democrats need in Congress, and I'm proud to be counted among his supporters in this campaign. He's ready to get to work to fix our broken political system and deliver for his community. Onward to November!

stances.summary: Calls for unity to win November elections
stances.quote: The stakes are high this November - and people from across the country are watching to see if we'll come together to win. I know we will.

stances.summary: Calls for coalition-building to win elections and deliver policy results
stances.quote: This is our moment to pull together and build a strong coalition that can win, govern, and deliver a better everyday life in America.

stances.summary: Calls for Democratic mobilization and portrays stakes as fundamental
stances.quote: Join Michigan Democrats and me in Detroit this Friday, August 7th, as we kick off the general election and lay out what's at stake. We only have 90 days until Election Day - and it's going to take all of us to deliver a better future.

stances.summary: Frames Democratic victory as necessary to fix broken political system
stances.quote: Together, through the ballot box, we can change the direction of our country, fix our broken politics, and deliver an economy worthy of the American dream.

stances.summary: Criticizes Republican record on Epstein, Medicaid, SNAP, tariffs
stances.quote:
Republicans are losing because they can't run on their record. 

They can't run on covering up the Epstein files. 
They can't run on cutting Medicaid.
They can't run on stripping SNAP or imposing tariffs. 

Americans see what is happening - and we are hungry for change.

stances.summary: Suggests political leadership obscures public consensus on policy priorities
stances.quote: Most of us actually agree on the biggest things we must do to make life better in this country - despite what the people in power right now want you to believe.

stances.summary: Calls for bold systemic reforms beyond rhetorical acknowledgment
stances.quote: The fact that the system is broken is so obvious that it has become a cliché when politicians say it. So why aren't we taking the necessary big swings to fix it?

stances.summary: Argues U.S. political system breakdown threatens American dream
stances.quote: The American dream is on the ropes, because the American political system has broken down. I talked with @The Diary Of A CEO about what needs to change in America today.

stances.summary: Calls for systemic political reform and bolder legislative action
stances.quote: We see that our political system is broken, then keep behaving as if it worked. We need serious change, and it's time to take bigger swings.

stances.summary: Argues political system reform needed for affordability
stances.quote: To make life easier and more affordable in this country, we must confront and fix what's wrong with our political system.

stances.summary: Calls for Congressional reform, Supreme Court reform, and campaign finance limits
stances.quote:
Fix Congress. Reform the Supreme Court. End money in politics. We cannot be afraid to fight for big reforms. 

Whether it’s paying more at the pump or struggling to afford a mortgage, kitchen-table problems will only be solvable when we deliver more accountability in government.

stances.summary: Challenges Speaker Johnson's record during campaign
stances.quote: Speaker Johnson has a lot to answer for when he's out campaigning and trying to earn your support this year.

stances.quote: The U.S. economy is officially losing jobs. From lost manufacturing to higher costs, the economic failures of the Trump administration keep piling up. There’s no way to spin these dismal results, because Americans know they’re paying the price every day.

stances.summary: Attacks Trump-Vance administration for higher inflation despite cost-cutting promises
stances.quote: The Trump-Vance administration wants us to celebrate inflation rates that are *higher* than when they came into office. They promised to lower costs and keep us out of war, then did the opposite.

stances.summary: Argues wealthy nation can afford social programs
stances.quote: Don't let anyone tell us we can't have nice things - like good roads, schools, and health care - as if the world's richest nation couldn't possibly afford it.

stances.summary: Criticizes monopolies, argues systemic political reform needed
stances.quote:
Monopolies squeezing farmers. 

Consumers and workers squeezed on all sides.

Small businesses swamped by the big guys. 

Our economic reality will not change until we change what's wrong with our political system.

stances.summary: Opposes new Middle East military intervention, criticizes war costs
stances.quote: If you’ve had enough of the White House sending America’s service members and tax dollars into an endless new Middle East war, while gas prices are going up here at home, welcome aboard.

When he said his Iran war would be over in a few weeks, many believed that too.

Americans today are fed up with the cost of this war - and the lies.

stances.summary: Criticizes Trump's trade and military policies as harming Americans
stances.quote: Whether it's a trade war with Canada or an actual war with Iran, the pattern is the same: Americans are paying the price for the President's choices.

stances.quote: Wherever you sit in this big tent of ours, remember just how much we agree on - with each other, and with a strong majority of voters.

stances.quote:
The story of Vernon AME is not only about confronting the destructive forces of hatred. It is a story about faith, hope, and community - an enormously inspiring one. 

“We are going to survive it, and we’re going to survive it together.”
